description: This file contains a PHP class 'ApiGatewayClient' in the namespace Aws\ApiGateway. It extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with the AWS API Gateway service, including constructing the client with custom headers. The class mainly serves as a client interface with numerous API methods documented in the docblock.

classes.name: ApiGatewayClient
classes.description: Client for AWS API Gateway, extending AwsClient, with custom header handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ApiGatewayClient, extending the parent constructor and appending a build step to add an 'Accept: application/json' header.

methods.name: _add_accept_header
methods.description: A static method that returns a handler which adds an 'Accept: application/json' header to requests.
